environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on identical EC2 infrastructure, but fronted by an AWS CloudFront distribution with a custom origin request policy. The CloudFront distribution has an associated AWS WAF WebACL containing: (1) a token-bucket rate-based rule scoped to the URI path '/api/v1/diagnostic' and '/api/v1/batch-diagnostic' with a threshold of 5 requests per 5-minute evaluation window per source IP, action BLOCK returning 429; (2) the rate evaluation uses a forwarded-for header inspection with fallback to socket IP. The rate-based rule has priority 1 and evaluates before any other rules. CloudFront caching is disabled for POST methods (behavior configured with CachingDisabled managed policy). Origin connection uses a custom header X-Origin-Verify for origin access restriction. Note: the WAF rate rule does NOT inspect request bodies or validate command safety - it purely limits request volume per IP to the diagnostic endpoints.

config.infrastructure: AWS CloudFront -> WAF WebACL -> ALB -> EC2
config.cloudfront_behavior: POST methods forwarded to origin, CachingDisabled policy
config.origin_access: Custom header X-Origin-Verify required, ALB rule rejects without it
config.network: EC2 security group allows inbound only from CloudFront managed prefix list
